title: A small book club
description: A fictional reading list demonstrating how to make your own. The book titles are invented; example.org links are placeholders, not reading material.
recallPrompt: What stayed with you? Describe a scene or argument before looking back.
notePrompt: What would you like to discuss with the group?

sections.title: First meeting
sections.description: Start with a physical book. A reading does not need a web link.

items.title: The Imaginary Garden
items.byline: An invented book for this example
items.description:
Read chapters 1–3 in your own copy.

Choose one passage to discuss; bring its page number.
items.why: Practice separating what the narrator observes from what they infer.

items.title: Looking twice
items.description: Compare the fictional essay with its fictional response. Replace both placeholder URLs with your own sources.

items.title: Finish The Imaginary Garden
items.description: Complete these chapters in your own copy. Mark each part as you finish it.

parts.title: Chapter 4
parts.description: Look for a change in the narrator's perspective.

parts.title: Chapter 5
parts.description: Compare the ending with your first impression.
